readerSummary: The portfolio preserves an inhabited practice inside a clear Technical Project Manager / Product Operations / Implementation role. The recurring work is to make room for people to enter, influence the form, recover context, and continue. Hosting, shared cultural space, public campaigns, and source-backed memory are presented as operating work with participation and care, not as personal charisma or an artist biography.

criteria.evidence: Homepage names the literal professional role and links to About. One click reaches 'Systems people can inhabit', a bounded Open House claim and an explicit artistic/civic/technical/social connection. The same section links onward to projects. The homepage's 'screen and room' pairing also gives this relation visual form.

Sunday Dinner/196 provides two inspectable handoff reconstructions; FairRentNYC shows a shared action surface, working-session photograph and public room with separate evidentiary limits; WOWList connects community vocabulary, collaborative event entry and organizer distribution with a returning consented tester threshold. These are three project continuities, with historical and present status explicitly distinguished.

Residency orientation learns what the artist needs, configures the space, gives independent access and remains available for changes. Coalition records let collaborators recover decisions rather than depend on one person. WOWList lets organizers use their own community language and distribute calendars. People are participants who can shape and continue a system.

The Open House sentence credits communal decision-making; the full article is not reproduced in the supplied review material. The source note excludes educational records and unapproved testimonial use. Project captions and source notes retain collective credit and privacy limits; no vulnerability story or participant exposure is used to manufacture authority.
This judge assigns 4. Two other independent reviews are needed to establish the required median and no-score-below-3 condition.
